title: Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields

result.label: Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields
result.statement: Gives a uniform deterministic algorithm that completely factors every nonzero dense degree- n polynomial over a prime field 𝔽 p , including multiplicities, in bit complexity polynomial in (n+1) p. The prime is supplied in binary. No randomness, integer-factorization or primitive-root oracle, or GRH assumption is required.
